name: Teleport Attack (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Teleport or greater teleport spell-like ability, Knowledge Arcana 13 ranks

Benefit(s): You can teleport attack (see below) an opponent if it fails a Fortitude save (DC 17 + your Charisma modifier). A creature that makes its save is immune to your teleport attack for 24 hours.
